title: Strongest Combination
statement:
Choose any subset of the numbers `a_1 ... a_n` (possibly empty, possibly all) and take the bitwise XOR of the chosen numbers; the empty subset gives `0`. Print the largest XOR you can get.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the largest XOR of a subset.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 9000`
- `0 <= a_i < 2^60`
